test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Noted dance historian Dr. Sunil Kothari was awarded Madhabdev Award in 2019 by the Government of Assam for popularizing which dance form of the state?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sattriya**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Sunil Kothari** was awarded the Madhabdev Award in 2019.
 
• The award was given by the Government of Assam.
 
• The award recognized his contribution to **popularizing Sattriya**.
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the classical dance forms of India, originating from Assam.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Bihu
 **Bihu**: A popular folk dance of Assam, typically performed during the Bihu festival.
 
 

 Bagurumba
 **Bagurumba**: A traditional dance of the Bodo community in Assam.
 
 

 Sattriya
 **Sattriya**: A classical dance form of Assam, attributed to the Vaishnavite monasteries of Assam.
 
 

 Ojapali
 **Ojapali**: A traditional folk dance and musical form of Assam, often associated with mythological stories.
